audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Akshan with a "camouflage passive" / "passive camo from bushes" — in whys[1], spikes[0].text, content.early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]. That champion does not exist.
audit.why: Akshan's passive is Dirty Fighting: every third hit from attacks and abilities deals bonus damage and shields him against champions, and each attack fires a reduced-damage second shot he can cancel for Move Speed. The camouflage is on W (Going Rogue), a 5500-range activated ability on 18/14/10/6/2. Nothing in his kit gives free brush stealth.
audit.corrected: Every camouflage-passive reference rebuilt on Dirty Fighting's shield and on Going Rogue as an activated roam tool; wants.you[0] now tells the reader to sweep, since camouflage is beaten by a sweeper.
sources: enemyKit W text and stealth flag

audit.why: The three full-layer whys under those rows are the generic Azir boilerplate ("Emperor's Divide online", "Nashor's spike", "Full build Azir is a teamfight") that appears verbatim on other matchups, so they are template, not a judgement about Akshan. audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing's two hard constraints were never stated: it must anchor on terrain, and he is knocked off it by colliding with a champion or terrain.
audit.why: Riot's E text says exactly that. It makes his entry line readable and interruptible, which is the single most useful thing an Azir can know in this lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and ahead.

audit.why: Akshan has no heal, drain or lifesteal in his kit — Dirty Fighting grants a SHIELD, which Grievous Wounds does not touch. Anti-heal buys nothing.

notes: The camouflage-passive error was the big one here: five separate fields taught the reader that Akshan has free brush stealth as a passive. He does not — the passive is Dirty Fighting (three-hit bonus damage plus a shield vs champions, and a second reduced-damage shot per attack) and the camouflage is the activated W. A reader warding against a passive that does not exist loses the lane for a reason the page invented. Level chart: I moved full phases[4..6] to Akshan to match content and packet, which agreed with each other against a full layer whose whys were verbatim Azir boilerplate. I am less than fully confident Akshan should own the 2+ items row against a full-build Azir — flagged in questionsForUser. breakdown.late left as generic Azir boilerplate; nothing in Akshan's kit gives a specific late statement I can source. Riot's W text in the kit file is truncated mid-word ("moving towards Scoundr"), so I did not assert anything about the camouflage's Scoundrel condition.
